annotations.title: Reference check questions or call analysis

description: Reference check questions or call analysis — Without notes: a reference-call script for a role (opening, questions with what to listen for, closing); questions touching protected topics (age, family, health, religion, national origin, salary history...) are removed offline and a would-you-work-with-them-again question is guaranteed. With notes=: summary, strengths, concerns, red flags, follow-ups and STRONG/POSITIVE/MIXED/CONCERNING, plus offline hedge-phrase, rehire and off-limits-topic signals. Params: role (required), candidate, notes, focus. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_reference_check
